name: flute
description: v7: a thin silver flute stands perpendicular to the wall (axis along local +Y) as the only mount (no side pins). A small maple striker board (planner 0.62 x 0.09 face, top at z=+0.045) is mounted on the flute's front end so the contact point and normal match the planner. Gold keys, a lip plate and tone holes sit on the tube in the backplate zone; a wall flange marks the far end.

contact.note: marble centre at hit = point + normal*R
